YOUR BUSINESS

Workspace setup

Set your language and currency first, then add your business or personal details. You can change these preferences later.

01

Language and currency

Start here. These preferences determine the language and currency used for new documents.

Currency changes apply to new documents. Existing documents retain the currency in which they were issued. CFA is set to the West African CFA franc (XOF).

02

Business profile and sender details

Complete this section so your name and contact details appear on every document you issue.

03

Backup and restore

Move your local data between devices.

Export a JSON backup containing your business profile and document history. Keep the file somewhere safe. Anyone with the file can read its contents.

Importing replaces the data currently stored in this browser. If your phone blocks a download or file selection, check the browser's site settings and Downloads permission. Websites cannot override these security controls.

Local data

Clearing data permanently removes documents and business details from this browser. Export a backup first.
